# .github

CI for every pull request and for `main` (`workflows/ci.yml`), and Dependabot (`dependabot.yml`): version updates of the pinned actions, and security updates only for npm (the repository's vulnerability alerts and automated security fixes are on, 2026-10-28). Copied from Vertex Food's `.github` and adapted.

## Rules
- Third-party actions are pinned to a full commit SHA with the tag in a comment; Dependabot proposes updates.
- The job names `Typecheck, lint, test, build` and `Secret scan` are the checks the `main: require CI` ruleset requires (added 2026-10-20 with the owner's approval). Renaming or splitting a job means updating the ruleset in the same PR, with the owner's approval. A new job goes in the `needs` of the `Typecheck, lint, test, build` gate, which waits for it, so the ruleset does not change.
- A step arrives with its first subject: the scenario book with its runner, the OpenAPI check with `apps/api` (#17), E2E with `apps/web` (#19).
- The scenario book: the `Tests` job runs `pnpm test:scenarios` after `pnpm test`, on the same PostgreSQL service; the runner creates its own database.
- `packages/db`: the `Tests` job runs a PostgreSQL 17 service (fake passwords that exist only for the job), `pnpm db:setup-local` and `pnpm db:migrate` before `pnpm test`; the database tests create their own database per run. The static job checks migration drift: `pnpm db:generate` must leave `packages/db/migrations` unchanged.
- `pnpm audit --prod` accepts only advisories listed with a reason in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`auditConfig.ignoreGhsas`); none is listed today.
- The migration guard (`pnpm check:migrations`, ADR 0008) runs in the static job over `packages/db/migrations/*.sql`, with the table registry of `packages/db`.
- The error-code guard (`pnpm check:error-codes`, ADR 0006) runs in the static job against the pull request's base commit (the push's previous commit on `main`), so the static checkout fetches the full history.
- The OpenAPI guard (`pnpm check:openapi`, ADR 0006) runs in the static job against the same base, after `node scripts/tools.mjs install oasdiff` installs the pinned oasdiff (version and SHA-256 in `scripts/tools.mjs`, which `pnpm verify` uses too). The `Tests` job installs it too, for the guard's own tests, and ends with `pnpm build` and `pnpm check:boot`: the built API and worker start on the migrated development database.
- Pull requests that change only Markdown skip the checks; the gate job still reports, so the ruleset and auto-merge work. The scenario book (`docs/scenarios/`) is executed as tests, and `brand/` is read by the token tests, so a change in either runs the checks.
- CI runs the same root commands as the `AGENTS.md` commands table; a new check gets a root script first, then a step here.
- No secrets in workflows beyond `GITHUB_TOKEN` and Turborepo's remote cache (`TURBO_TOKEN`, `TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY`, with the variables `TURBO_TEAM` and `TURBO_API`), which only the jobs that run turbo (static, `Tests` and the Playwright shards) get; the cache stays off until the owner adds them (`docs/testing.md`, "CI"). Deploys never run from CI without an ADR.
- Turborepo's cache is kept between runs with `actions/cache`, per job: a pull request reads its own runs' cache and `main`'s, and `main` cannot read a pull request's, so after a merge `main` runs what the pull request changed once more. `turbo.json` has `remoteCache.signature`, so remote artifacts are signed and checked.
- E2E (`docs/testing.md`, "E2E"): the `Playwright shard 1` and `2` jobs run `pnpm test:e2e --shard=<n>/2` (the `test:e2e` task builds `apps/web` first and Playwright serves the build) in Playwright's image, pinned by tag and digest to the `@playwright/test` version of `apps/web`, as the runner's user (1001); the image's `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` reaches Playwright through the task's `passThroughEnv` in `turbo.json`. The image carries Chromium, its libraries and fonts: installing them with `--with-deps` took up to 13 minutes on slow Ubuntu mirrors. `packages/config/test/ci.test.ts` fails when the two versions differ, so a Playwright update changes the image in the same PR. The gate waits for both shards, so the ruleset is unchanged. Each shard uploads its report and the RTL screenshots (`playwright-report-<n>`, 14 days). Sessions run the whole suite once before the PR (`pnpm verify --e2e-all`).
- The secret scan pins gitleaks (`GITLEAKS_VERSION`) to the release `pnpm verify` runs (`scripts/tools.mjs`); `ci.test.ts` keeps them equal.
